_note: Demonstration fixtures for Tumakuru with geographic and hydrological grounding. Not authoritative municipal boundaries.

provenance.methodology: Ground-truthed against OpenStreetMap drainage/water bodies (Amanikere lake basin) and DEM elevation contours (~810m to ~845m above MSL).

zones.name: Amanikere Lake Inlet Lowlands
zones.geographic_justification: Low-lying catchment bordering Amanikere Lake basin (~812m elevation). Natural basin depression susceptible to stormwater accumulation during monsoon overflows.
zones.source_provenance: OSM Waterbody Contour + SRTM Topographic Lowland

zones.name: B.H. Road Commercial Corridor
zones.geographic_justification: Primary commercial arterial (Bangalore-Honnavar Road) with continuous concrete roadside storm drains prone to urban debris bottlenecks.
zones.source_provenance: OSM Primary Highway alignment + roadside culvert corridor

zones.name: Tumakuru Railway Station Road
zones.geographic_justification: Transit approach corridor adjacent to railway underbridge embankment; historical stormwater ponding choke point.
zones.source_provenance: OSM Station Road alignment + Underbridge culvert corridor

zones.name: Siddaganga Extension Crossings
zones.geographic_justification: Residential sector with moderate slope (~826m elevation). Well-drained secondary storm canals with occasional culvert siltation.
zones.source_provenance: OSM Residential polygon boundary + Municipal ward plan

zones.name: Ashoka Nagar Residential Ring
zones.geographic_justification: Gently undulating residential ring (~830m elevation); low baseline waterlogging vulnerability.

zones.name: M.G. Road Underpass Junction
zones.geographic_justification: Sub-surface vehicular underpass depression (~814m elevation); severe natural ponding sink during intense cloudbursts.

zones.name: Batawadi Bypass Corridor
zones.geographic_justification: Northern bypass highway corridor with roadside swale ditches; moderate run-off discharge capacity.

zones.name: Gubbi Gate Market Lowlands
zones.geographic_justification: Dense legacy market basin with narrow covered storm drains; prone to solid-waste induced blockage.
zones.source_provenance: OSM Commercial market zone + Western stormwater drainage tributary

zones.name: University Campus Elevated Ridge
zones.geographic_justification: High natural ridge topography (~842m elevation); natural shedding of surface run-off with minimal inundation risk.
zones.source_provenance: OSM Campus Polygon + SRTM Topographic Ridge

zones.name: Kyathsandra Service Road Approach
zones.geographic_justification: Eastern highway frontage road with open culvert flow; low baseline risk.
